system.description:
Beginning at 3rd Level you learn maneuvers that are fueled by a special dice called Superiority Dice.

Maneuvers: You learn four maneuvers of your choice, which are detailed in the Barrier Maneuvers Section at the end of this class. You earn more at higher levels as shown in the “Maneuvers Known” Column of the Superior Defense table. Many Maneuvers enhance your allies in some way. You can use one maneuver as part of an attack or jutsu casting, once each.
